versions.changelog:
- Improved Chinese description for clarity and conciseness; now highlights key features and usage scenarios.
- Expanded and refined trigger keyword list for better discoverability.
- Added a "功能概览" (feature overview) table for quick understanding of capabilities.
- Added section with ClawHub release/installation info at the end.
- No changes to technical workflow, usage, or supported features.

- Initial release of the exam-paper skill: generate exam and answer PDFs from a question bank.
- Supports question bank management: view, add, delete, query questions by subject (default: informatics).
- Implements error tracking: record, review, and mark wrong answers for focused revision.
- Randomized selection of questions and PDF export are provided via command-line scripts.
- Extensible design for adding new subjects and customizing exam formats.
